name: screen-polish
description: Polishes Claude Code's terminal: inline code on a background, distinct heading levels, drawn rules, task-list checkboxes and quote bars in replies, plus optional tool-call rows, prompt marker and spinner words. Each one turns on or off in /config.

inlineCode.title: Inline code on a background
inlineCode.description: Draws `code` in replies as a chip on a background, so it stands apart from bold text.

headings.title: Heading levels
headings.description: Gives reply headings distinct levels: # and ## in the accent color, # underlined, #### and below in italics.

rules.title: Drawn rules
rules.description: Draws --- in replies as a line across the transcript instead of the literal dashes.

taskLists.title: Task list checkboxes
taskLists.description: Draws - [ ] and - [x] in replies as ○ and a green ✓, the done items dimmed.

quotes.title: Quote bars
quotes.description: Draws > quotes in replies in italics behind a bar, with inline code still on its background.

toolRows.title: Tool calls as rows
toolRows.description: One aligned row per tool call with a status glyph and a short result; under it only an edit's diff or a failure's detail.

promptMarker.title: Prompt marker
promptMarker.description: An accent ❯ before each prompt you send.

spinnerWords.title: Spinner says what's happening
spinnerWords.description: The spinner names what the turn is doing (Waiting, Writing, Running) instead of a random word.

modeLabels.title: Mode labels joined by ·
modeLabels.description: Joins the session's mode labels with · instead of &.
